hooks.command: PATH="$PATH:$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/go/bin:$HOME/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin"; umask 077; q="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)/.entire/tmp/devin-pending"; if command -v entire >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v entire-agent-devin >/dev/null 2>&1; then for f in "$q"/*; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; if entire hooks devin "${f##*.}" <"$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then rm -f "$f"; else mkdir -p "$q/failed" && mv -f "$f" "$q/failed/"; fi; done; entire hooks devin post-compaction; else mkdir -p "$q" && cat >"$q/.$$" && mv -f "$q/.$$" "$q/$(date +%s)-$(printf %06d "$(ls "$q" | wc -l)")-$$.post-compaction"; fi; exit 0
